narrative.intro: Harris recorded $1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Harris won 11 awards so far this fiscal year, producing an average award size of $94.9M and obligations that are up 13.7% year over year. Harris obligations have trended upward over the last six fiscal years: FY21 was $376M, FY22 was $313M, FY23 was $386M, FY24 was $459M, FY25 was $918M, and FY26 is $1B. Harris remains a multi-award federal vendor this fiscal year, with a concentration in a relatively small number of large awards given the average award size. Harris year-over-year growth reflects higher current-year spending compared with the prior fiscal year levels. Harris total and per-award figures here are contract obligations for the fiscal year to date, and some award-value tables use total contract value rather than obligation amounts where noted.
